manifest.name: temporal-tests
manifest.description: Every top-level test of the Temporal ./tests package, generated from its test list

workload.invariant: passes through the one-box cluster under virtual time

TestListWorkflow_OrQuery.reason: Lists executions whose start times tie and expects the newest run first; the SQLite visibility store breaks equal close/start times by run_id ascending with no deterministic newest-first tie-break, and under virtual time every start in the test shares one instant, so the order follows run_id bits (advanced_visibility_test.go TestListWorkflow_OrQuery). Stock SQLite ordering is kept on purpose.

TestClientMiscTestSuite.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound on both seeds (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-28); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

TestDescribeTaskQueue.reason: Asserts the poller's LastAccessTime is strictly after a time.Now() read before the poll; under virtual time both reads fall in one instant and no server ordering can separate them (describe_test.go:294).

Test_Activity_Basic.reason: Measures dispatch fairness over a backlog it assumes is fully written before activity polling starts; under virtual time server work takes no time, so polling begins while later workflows' activity tasks are still in transfer and the first 66 dispatched tasks come from 4 of 15 workflows (unfairness 1.03-1.04 on seeds 11 and 17 against 0.45 under stock go test, threshold 1.0; priority_fairness_test.go:603).
